english_title: 45. Farewell to the Month of Ramadan

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, O He who desires no repayment!
2.O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهُ عَلَى السَّوآءِ،
phrases.english: 3.O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!
4.Your kindness is a new beginning, Your pardon gratuitous bounty,
5.Your punishment justice, Your decree a choice for the best!

phrases.arabic: إنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَآءَكَ بِمَنٍّ،
phrases.english: 6.If You bestowest, You stainest not Your bestowal with obligation,

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّيا
phrases.english: 7.and if You withholdest, You withholdest not in transgression.

phrases.arabic: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَأَنْتَ أَلْهَمْتَهُ شُكْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 8.You showest gratitude to him who thanks You, while You hast inspired him to thank You.

phrases.arabic: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهُ حَمْدَكَ،
phrases.english: 9.You rewardest him who praises You, while though You hast taught him Your praise.

phrases.arabic: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهُ
phrases.english: 10.You coverest him whom, if You willed, You wouldst expose,

phrases.arabic: وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهُ،
phrases.english: 11.and You art generous toward him from whom, if You willed, You wouldst withhold.
12.Both are worthy of Your exposure and withholding,

phrases.arabic: غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ أَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ،
phrases.english: 13.but You hast founded Your acts upon gratuitous bounty,
14.channelled Your power into forbearance,
15.received him who disobeyed You with clemency,
16.and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.

phrases.arabic: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِأَنَاتِكَ إِلَى الْإِنَابَةِ ، وَ تَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ إِلَى التَّوْبَةِ
phrases.english: 17.You awaitest their turning back without haste and refrainest from rushing them toward repentance,
18.so that the perisher among them may not perish because of You
19.and the wretched may not be wretched through Your favour,
20.but only after Your prolonged excusing him
21.and successive arguments against him,
22.as an act of generosity through Your pardon, O Generous,
23.and an act of kindliness through Your tenderness, O Clement!
24.It is You who hast opened for Your servants a door
25.to Your pardon, which You hast named 'repentance'.

phrases.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ دَلِيلًا مِنْ وَحْيِكَ
phrases.english: 26.You hast placed upon that door a pointer from Your revelation,

phrases.arabic: لِئَلاَّ يَضِلُّوا عَنْهُ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ :
phrases.english: 27.lest they stray from it: You hast said (blessed is Your Name),

phrases.arabic: )تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ
phrases.english: 28."Repent toward God with unswerving repentance! It may be that Your Lord
29.will acquit of your evil deeds and will admit you into
30.gardens beneath which rivers flow,
31.upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ
phrases.english: 32.and those who have faith along with him, their light running before them and on their right hands,

phrases.arabic: يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
phrases.english: 33.and they say: 'Our Lord, complete for us our light, and forgive us!
34.Surely You art powerful over everything" (66:8).

phrases.arabic: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ ذلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ
phrases.english: 35.What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering that house
36.after the opening of the door and the setting up of the pointer?

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي زِدْتَ فِي السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ
phrases.english: 37.It is You who hast raised the price against Yourself to the advantage of Your servants,
38.desiring their profit in their trade with You,
39.their triumph through reaching You, and their increase on account of You,
40.for You hast said (blessed is Your Name and high art You exalted),
41."Whoso brings a good deed shall have ten the like of it,

phrases.arabic: وَمَن جَاء بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلاَ يُجْزَى إِلاَّ مِثْلَهَا(
phrases.english: 42.and whoso brings an evil deed shall only be recompensed the like of it" (6:160).

phrases.arabic: وَقُلْتَ): مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ
phrases.english: 43.You hast said, "The likeness of those who expend their wealth in the way of God is as the likeness of a grain of corn

phrases.arabic: أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنبُلَةٍ مِّئَةُ حَبَّةٍ
phrases.english: 44.that sprouts seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains;
45.so God multiplies unto whom He wills" (2:261).

phrases.arabic: وَقُلْتَ): مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا
phrases.english: 46.You hast said, "Who is he that will lend to God a good loan,
47.and He will multiply it for him manifold" (2:245)?

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
phrases.english: 48.And You hast sent down in the Qur'an similar verses on the multiplying of good deeds.

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَتَرْغِيْبِكَ
phrases.english: 49.It is You who hast pointed them through Your speech from Your Unseen and Your encouragement

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهُ عَنْهُمْ
phrases.english: 50.in which lies their good fortune toward that which - hadst You covered it from them

phrases.arabic: لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَعِـهِ أَسْمَاعُهُمْ
phrases.english: 51.their eyes would not have perceived, their ears would not have heard,
52.and their imaginations would not have grasped,

phrases.arabic: فَقُلْتَ):فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُواْ لِي وَلاَ تَكْفُرُونِ(
phrases.english: 53.for You hast said, "Remember Me and I will remember you be thankful to Me, and be you not thankless towards Me" (2:152)!
54.You hast said, "If you are thankful, surely I will increase you,
55.but if you are thankless, My chastisement is surely terrible" (14:7);
56.And You hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you,
57.surely those who wax too proud to worship Me
58.shall enter Gehenna utterly abject" (40:60).
59.Hence You hast named supplicating You 'worship' and refraining from it 'waxing proud',

phrases.arabic: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهِ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ،
phrases.english: 60.and You hast threatened that the refraining from it would yield entrance into Gehenna in utter abjection.
61.So they remember You for Your kindness, they thank You for Your bounty,
62.they supplicate You by Your command,
63.and they donate for You in order to seek Your increase;
64.in all this lies their deliverance from Your wrath
65.and their triumph through Your good pleasure.

phrases.arabic: وَلَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقاً مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
phrases.english: 66.Were any creature himself to direct another creature

phrases.arabic: عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ
phrases.english: 67.to the like of that to which You Yourself hast directed Your servants,
68.he would be described by beneficence,
69.qualified by kindness, and praised by every tongue.

phrases.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِي حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ،
phrases.english: 70.So to You belongs praise as long as there is found a way to praise You

phrases.arabic: وَمَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهِ، وَ مَعْنًى يَنْصَرِفُ إِلَيْهِ.
phrases.english: 71.and as long as there remains for praising words by which You may be praised and meanings which may be spent in praise!

phrases.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إِلَى عِبَادِهِ بِالْإِحْسَانِ وَالْفَضْلِ،
phrases.english: 72.O He who shows Himself praiseworthy to His servants through beneficence and bounty,
73.flooding them with kindness and graciousness!

phrases.arabic: مَا أَفْشَى فِيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ،
phrases.english: 74.How much Your favour has been spread about among us, Your kindness lavished upon us,
75.and Your goodness singled out for us!
76.You hast guided us to Your religion which You hast chosen,
77.Your creed with which You art pleased,
78.and Your path which You hast made smooth,

phrases.arabic: وَبَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ وَالوُصُولَ إلَى كَـرَامَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 79.and You hast shown us proximity to You and arrival at Your generosity!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ  وَأَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَـايَـا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ
phrases.english: 80.O God, You hast appointed among the choicest of those duties
81.and the most special of those obligations

phrases.arabic: شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ،
phrases.english: 82.the month of Ramadan, which You hast singled out from other months,
83.chosen from among all periods and eras,
84.and preferred over all times of the year

phrases.arabic: بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالنُّورِ،
phrases.english: 85.through the Qur'an and the Light which You sent down within it,
86.the faith which You multiplied by means of it,
87.the fasting which You obligated therein,
88.the standing in prayer which You encouraged at its time,
89.and the Night of Decree which You magnified therein,

phrases.arabic: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر،
phrases.english: 90.the night which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3).

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الأُمَمِ
phrases.english: 91.Through it You hast preferred us over the other communities
92.and through its excellence You hast chosen us to the exclusion of the people of the creeds.
93.We fasted by Your command in its daylight,
94.we stood in prayer with Your help in its night,

phrases.arabic: مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 95.presenting ourselves by its fasting and its standing to the mercy which You hast held up before us,
96.and we found through it the means to Your reward.

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الْمَليءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيهِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 97.And You art full of what is sought from You,
98.munificent with what is asked of Your bounty,
99.and near to him who strives for Your nearness.

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ أَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مُقَامَ حَمْدٍ
phrases.english: 100.This month stood among us in a standing place of praise,
101.accompanied us with the companionship of one approved,
102.and profited us with the most excellent profit of the world's creatures.

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهِ وَانْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهِ وَوَفَاءِ عَدَدِهِ،
phrases.english: 103.Then it parted from us at the completion of its time, the end of its term, and the fulfilment of its number.

phrases.arabic: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهُ عَلَيْنَا
phrases.english: 104.So we bid farewell to it with the farewell of one whose parting pains us,
105.whose leaving fills us with gloom and loneliness,
106.and to whom we have come to owe a safeguarded claim,
107.an observed inviolability, and a discharged right.
108.We say: Peace be upon You,

phrases.arabic: يَا شَهْرَ اللَّهِ الْأَكْبَرَ، وَيَا عِيْدَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ.
phrases.english: 109.O greatest month of God! O festival of His friends!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَكْرَمَ مَصْحُوبٍ مِنَ الْأَوْقَاتِ،
phrases.english: 110.Peace be upon You, O most noble of accompanying times!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا خَيْرَ شَهْرٍ فِي الْأَيَّامِ وَالسَّاعَاتِ.
phrases.english: 111.O best of months in days and hours!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الْآمَالُ
phrases.english: 112.Peace be upon You, month in which expectations come near
113.and good works are scattered about!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِينٍ جَلَّ قَدْرُهُ مَوْجُوداً،
phrases.english: 114.Peace be upon You, comrade who is great in worth when found

phrases.arabic: وَأَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهُ مَفْقُوداً، وَمَرْجُوٍّ آلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ.
phrases.english: 115.and who torments through absence when lost, anticipated friend whose parting gives pain!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَلِيفٍ آنَسَ مُقْبِلًا فَسَرَّ
phrases.english: 116.Peace be upon You, familiar who brought comfort in coming, thus making happy,
117.who left loneliness in going, thus giving anguish!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِرٍ رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَقَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ.
phrases.english: 118.Peace be upon You, neighbour in whom hearts became tender and sins became few!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِرٍ أَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ
phrases.english: 119.Peace be upon You, helper who aided against Satan,
120.companion who made easy the paths of good-doing!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ
phrases.english: 121.Peace be upon You - How many became freedmen of God within You!

phrases.arabic: وَمَا أَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ  بكَ!.
phrases.english: 122.How happy those who observed the respect due to You!

phrases.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ،
phrases.english: 123.Peace be upon You - How many the sins You erased!
124.How many the kinds of faults You covered over!

phrases.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ،
phrases.english: 125.Peace be upon You - How drawn out wert You for the sinners!
126.How awesome wert You in the hearts of the faithful!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ لَا تُنَافِسُهُ الْأَيَّامُ.
phrases.english: 127.Peace be upon You, month with which no days compete!

phrases.arabic: أالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ سَلَامٌ.
phrases.english: 128.Peace be upon You, month which is peace in all affairs!
129.Peace be upon You, You whose companionship is not disliked,
130.You whose friendly mixing is not blamed!

phrases.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ،
phrases.english: 131.Peace be upon You, just as You hast entered upon us with blessings
132.and cleansed us of the defilement of offenses!
133.Peace be upon You - You art not bid farewell in annoyance
134.nor is Your fasting left in weariness!

phrases.arabic: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوبِ قَبْلَ  وَقْتِهِ
phrases.english: 135.Peace be upon You, object of seeking before Your time,
136.object of sorrow before Your passing!

phrases.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوءٍ صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
phrases.english: 137.Peace be upon You - How much evil was turned away from us through You!

phrases.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ أُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا.
phrases.english: 138.How much good flowed upon us because of You!
139.Peace be upon You and upon the Night of Decree

phrases.arabic: الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر.
phrases.english: 140.which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3)!

phrases.arabic: أالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَحْرَصَنَا بِالْأَمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 141.Peace be upon You - How much we craved You yesterday!
142.How intensely we shall yearn for You tomorrow!

phrases.arabic: أَلسَلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي حُرِمْنَاهُ ،
phrases.english: 143.Peace be upon You and upon Your bounty which has now been made unlawful to us
144.and upon Your blessings gone by which have now been stripped away from us!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا أَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الَّذِي شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ
phrases.english: 145.O God, we are the people of this month. Through it You hast ennobled us

phrases.arabic: وَوَفَّقْتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهُ حِينَ جَهِلَ الْأَشْقِيَاءُ وَقْتَهُ
phrases.english: 146.and given us success because of Your kindness, while the wretched are ignorant of its time.
147.Made unlawful to them is its bounty because of their wretchedness.

phrases.arabic: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 148.You art the patron of the knowledge of it by which You hast preferred us,
149.and its prescribed practices to which You hast guided us.

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ عَلى تَقْصِير،
phrases.english: 150.We have undertaken, through Your giving success, its fasting and its standing in prayer, but with shortcomings,
151.and we have performed little of much.
152.O God, so to You belongs praise, in admission of evil doing

phrases.arabic: وَاعْتِرَافاً بِالْإِضَاعَةِ، وَلَكَ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ،
phrases.english: 153.and confession of negligence, and to You belongs remorse firmly knitted in our hearts
154.and seeking of pardon sincerely uttered by our tongues.

phrases.arabic: فَأْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا أَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ
phrases.english: 155.Reward us, in spite of the neglect that befell us in this month,

phrases.arabic: أَجْراً نَسْتَدْرِكُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ،
phrases.english: 156.with a reward through which we may reach the bounty desired from it

phrases.arabic: وَنَعْتَاضُ بِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ ،
phrases.english: 157.and win the varieties of its craved stores!

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ،
phrases.english: 158.Make incumbent upon us Your pardon for our falling short of Your right in this month

phrases.arabic: وَابْلُغْ بِأَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ،
phrases.english: 159.and make our lives which lie before us reach the coming month of Ramadan!
160.Once You hast made us reach it, help us perform
161.the worship of which You art worthy,

phrases.arabic: وَأَدِّنَا إلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ
phrases.english: 162.cause us to undertake the obedience which You deservest,
163.and grant us righteous works

phrases.arabic: مَا يَكُونُ دَرَكاً لِحَقِّكَ فِي الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ.
phrases.english: 164.that we may fulfil Your right in these two months of the months of time.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ مَا أَلْمَمْنَا بِهِ فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَمٍ أَوْ إِثْمٍ،
phrases.english: 165.O God, as for the small and large sins which we have committed in this our month,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبِ وَاكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَة
phrases.english: 166.the misdeeds into which we have fallen, and the offenses which we have earned

phrases.arabic: عَلَى تَعَمُّدٍ مِنَّا ، أَوْ عَلَى نِسْيَانٍ ظَلَمْنَا فِيهِ أَنْفُسَنَا ، أَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهِ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا
phrases.english: 167.purposefully or in forgetfulness, wronging ourselves thereby or violating the respect due to others,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 168.bless Muhammad and his Household, cover us over with Your covering,
169.pardon us through Your pardoning,
170.place us not before the eyes of the gloaters because of that,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَبْسُطْ  عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ أَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنينَ،
phrases.english: 171.stretch not toward us the tongues of the defamers,
172.and employ us in that which will alleviate and expiate

phrases.arabic: لِمَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَأْفَتِكَ  الَّتِي لاَ تَنْفَدُ،
phrases.english: 173.whatever You disapprovest from us within it through Your clemency which does not run out,
174.and Your bounty which does not diminish!
175.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
176.redress our being afflicted by our month,
177.bless us in this day of our festival and our fast-breaking,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا أَجْلَبِهِ لِعَفْوٍ، وَأَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبٍ،
phrases.english: 178.make it one of the best of days that have passed over us, the greatest in attracting Your pardon, and the most effacing toward sins,

phrases.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لَنا ما خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَمَا عَلَنَ.
phrases.english: 179.and forgive us our sins, both the concealed and the public!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اسْلَخْنَا بِاِنْسِلَاخٍ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا
phrases.english: 180.O God, with the passing of this month make us pass forth from our offenses,
181.with its departure make us depart from our evil deeds,
182.and appoint us thereby among its most felicitous people,

phrases.arabic: وَأَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسَمَاً فِيـهِ وَأَوْفَـرِهِمْ حَظّاً مِنْـهُ.
phrases.english: 183.the most plentiful of them in portion, and the fullest of them in share!

phrases.arabic: أللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ رَعَى حَقَّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ
phrases.english: 184.O God, when any person observes this month as it should be observed,

phrases.arabic: وَحَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهُ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا وَقَامَ بِحُدُودِهِ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا،
phrases.english: 185.safeguards its inviolability as it should be safeguarded, attends to its bounds as they should be attended to,

phrases.arabic: وَأتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهُ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا أَوْ تَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَة
phrases.english: 186.fears its misdeeds as they should be feared, or seeks nearness to You with any act of nearness-seeking

phrases.arabic: أَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهُ وَعَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 187.which makes incumbent upon him Your good pleasure and bends toward him Your mercy,
188.give to us the like [of that] from Your wealth
189.and bestow it upon us in multiples through Your bounty,

phrases.arabic: فَإنَّ فَضْلَكَ، لا يَغِيْضُ وَإنَّ خَـزَائِنَكَ لا تَنْقُصُ، بَـلْ تَفِيضُ
phrases.english: 190.for Your bounty does not diminish, Your treasuries do not decrease but overflow,
191.the mines of Your beneficence are not exhausted,
192.and Your bestowal is the bestowal full of delight!
193.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ اُجُوْرِ مَنْ صَامَهُ
phrases.english: 194.and write for us the like of the wages of him who fasted in it

phrases.arabic: أَوْ  تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيْهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
phrases.english: 195.or worshipped You within it until the Day of Resurrection!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا
phrases.english: 196.O God, we repent to You in our day of fast-breaking,
197.which You hast appointed for the faithful a festival and a joy

phrases.arabic: وَلِاَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعاً مُحْتَشَدًا مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْب أَذْنَبْنَاهُ،
phrases.english: 198.and for the people of Your creed a time of assembly and gathering, from every misdeed we did,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ سُوْءٍ أَسْلَفْنَاهُ، أَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ أَضْمَرْنَاهُ،
phrases.english: 199.ill work we sent ahead, or evil thought we secretly conceived,

phrases.arabic: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْطَوِيْ عَلَى رُجُوْعٍ إلَى ذَنْب
phrases.english: 200.the repentance of one who does not harbour a return to sin
201.and who afterwards will not go back to offense,

phrases.arabic: تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالْاِرْتِيَابِ،
phrases.english: 202.an unswerving repentance rid of doubt and wavering.

phrases.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا وَارْضَ عَنَّا وَثَبِّتنَا عَلَيْهَا.
phrases.english: 203.So accept it from us, be pleased with us, and fix us within it!
204.God, provide us with fear of the threatened punishment

phrases.arabic: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتّٰى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهِ،
phrases.english: 205.and yearning for the promised reward, so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate You
206.and the sorrow of that from which we seek sanctuary in You!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ،
phrases.english: 207.And place us with You among the repenters, those upon whom You hast made Your love obligatory

phrases.arabic: وَقَبِلْتَ  مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ، يَا أَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ.
phrases.english: 208.and from whom You hast accepted the return to obeying You! O Most Just of the just!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبآئِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَهْلِ دِيْنِنَا جَمِيعاً
phrases.english: 209.O God, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion,

phrases.arabic: مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
phrases.english: 210.those who have gone and those who will pass by, until the Day of Resurrection!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّنَا وَآلِهِ،
phrases.english: 211.O God, bless our prophet Muhammad and his Household,
212.as You hast blessed Your angels brought nigh,
213.bless him and his Household,
214.as You hast blessed Your prophets sent out,

phrases.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ،
phrases.english: 215.bless him and his Household, as You hast blessed Your righteous servants

phrases.arabic: وَأَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
phrases.english: 216.- and better than that, O Lord of the worlds!
217.a blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain to us,
218.and through which our supplication may be granted!
219.You art the most generous of those who are beseeched,
220.the most sufficient of those in whom confidence is had,
221.the most bestowing of those from whom bounty is asked,
You art powerful over everything!
